goal: Expand Chu-kei Insight Plan Detection coverage safely from the current 268 resolved companies out of the 3,709-company listed-company universe (7.2257%) to at least 371 resolved companies (10% or higher). Prioritize company-count breadth over unnecessary deep-detail enrichment. Reuse the existing candidate, source-audit, validation, canonical-data, public-sync, and resumable quality pipeline. Before changing derived override, registry, or site summary files, first create or complete genuine company-level primary-review evidence under the existing quality-rebase/source-research review paths for high-confidence official or first-party candidates. Do not increase coverage by weakening confirmation or full-text-review gates. Work in bounded resumable batches until the target is reached. Do not add unrelated product features unless they are required to remove a deterministic blocker to this coverage objective.
graduation_criteria: The canonical Plan Detection summary represents the intended listed-company universe and reports at least 371 resolved companies out of 3,709, corresponding to detectionCoverage of at least 0.10; if the authoritative universe size legitimately changes, the 10% threshold must be recalculated and the change documented rather than hidden.

Every newly resolved Plan Detection state is supported by official or first-party evidence with preserved company, source, document identity, publication date, plan/version/period or fiscal semantics, currentness boundaries, and provenance. Missing, ambiguous, or unreviewed evidence is never converted into no_formal_plan or another resolved state merely to increase coverage.

Coverage expansion is performed by completing genuine primary-review evidence first and only then rebuilding derived overrides/registry/site data. Existing requireFormalPlanConfirmed and requireFullTextHumanReviewComplete safeguards must not be weakened to manufacture coverage. Batches prioritize high-confidence official-source candidates and preserve validation safeguards against quarterly-document false positives, malformed plan periods, stale plans, and blanket or synthetic promotions.

Canonical data, generated site data, and public-product synchronization remain aligned after coverage changes. Search, browse, and company-detail behavior continue to operate on the broad universe, and any human-only publication or external promotion boundary remains explicit rather than silently auto-approved.

All repository validation, Plan Detection tests, quality gates, source/audit checks, and relevant production smoke/runtime checks are green for the final state, with no known deterministic pipeline blocker and with the autonomous pipeline remaining safely resumable for the next coverage milestone.
